# Third-party runtime injector

The optional module uses the unmodified official `frida-inject-16.7.19-android-arm` binary from https://github.com/frida/frida/releases/tag/16.7.19 . It is stored in the downloadable module asset, not in this source tree.

Upstream source: https://github.com/frida/frida/tree/16.7.19 , https://github.com/frida/frida-core/tree/16.7.19 and https://github.com/frida/frida-gum/tree/16.7.19 . Retained upstream license documents accompany the module.

Official binary SHA-256: `e865f8746cee97761af50a31528315baf14cc047eedd35242f30a744b91d25ea`.

The library licence text referred to by the upstream notices is retained as GNU-LIBRARY-GPL-2.0.txt, obtained from https://www.gnu.org/licenses/old-licenses/lgpl-2.0.txt .
